cohort: 773 premature deliveries less than 34 weeks from 10 centers in China between July 2014 and July 2016
finding: Preterm infants less than 34 weeks born to mothers with PIH had a higher risk of intrauterine growth restriction and lower birth weight.
mod_finding: Women with PIH tended to have a higher cesarean delivery rate (78.2% vs 40.9%, P < 0.001).
birth_weight: Lower in infants of PIH mothers than infants of non-PIH mothers (1522.1 ± 348.8 g vs 1683.4 ± 345.3, P < 0.001)
